verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents Volumes as persistent storage that survives instance destruction and can be reattached to new instances. Volumes can be managed from a Storage page and through the CLI, which covers datasets and checkpoints outliving a single rental. One community user wished persistent disks were easier to work with over time, a usability complaint rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: evidence that volumes are network-attached and usable across different host machines, detailed docs on attach/reattach workflow and limits, and independent hands-on corroboration.
